title: Q-ULTRA-self_shipping-REDESIGN: every second-order step failed to bring Self-originated releases back in bounds; redesign
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** ladder exhausted for `self_shipping`
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** closed

The same failure three times is a design defect (GUIDING-DIRECTIVE section 2): change the structure, not the parameter.

size: L

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `self_shipping` inside its bounds.


**Vacuous:** 2026-11-22T05:20:52Z vacuous: the probe was never recorded failing on this item, so its pass cannot show the defect is gone; rewrite the probe so it fails while the defect exists

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T05:51:29Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
